description: Import a Pine v5 or v6 strategy or indicator as a cubicle.script, with the runner's own importer (cubicle-script import-pine). It answers the script (YAML, validated before it is handed out), the importer's notes (where Pine and the runner differ: fills, warm-up, na) and its header. A construct outside the subset is refused, never guessed: each diagnostic names its code (C057 left out by design, C058 a second market, C059 not translated, C040 lookahead_on), the construct, its Pine line and what the code means. Say the refusal plainly and offer the rewrite the code suggests. At most 64 KB of Pine. Free.

market.description: the market the script reads (NQ, ES, BTC, ETH, SOL); the importer's default when left out

name.description: the script's name (lower case, digits, . _ -); imported when left out

tf.description: the bar size (1s, 15s, 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 4h, 1d); the importer's default when left out

name: script_import_pine
